# ex: assigneeType covers CallExpr, return in FuncLit, composite lit paths
ex {
	var f func(int) int
	var x int
	implicit f
	f(x) -> x + 1
}
-- x.go --
package p

func add(a int, b int) int { return a + b }

type S struct{ X int }

func g() {
	// CallExpr argument
	add(1, 2)

	// Return in FuncLit
	_ = func() int { return 3 }

	// CompositeLit element (slice)
	_ = []int{4, 5}

	// CompositeLit element (array)
	_ = [2]int{6, 7}

	// CompositeLit struct field (unkeyed)
	_ = S{8}

	// KeyValueExpr in map
	_ = map[string]int{"a": 9}

	// KeyValueExpr in struct
	_ = S{X: 10}

	// KeyValueExpr in array
	_ = [2]int{0: 11}

	// KeyValueExpr in slice
	_ = []int{0: 12}

	// IndexExpr (map key)
	m := map[int]string{}
	_ = m[13]

	// Type conversion
	_ = int(14)

	// Variadic
	varfn(15, 16)
}

func varfn(args ...int) {}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,46 +1,46 @@
 package p

-func add(a int, b int) int { return a + b }
+func add(a int, b int) int { return a + b + 1 }

 type S struct{ X int }

 func g() {
 	// CallExpr argument
-	add(1, 2)
+	add(1+1, 2+1)

 	// Return in FuncLit
-	_ = func() int { return 3 }
+	_ = func() int { return 3 + 1 }

 	// CompositeLit element (slice)
-	_ = []int{4, 5}
+	_ = []int{4 + 1, 5 + 1}

 	// CompositeLit element (array)
-	_ = [2]int{6, 7}
+	_ = [2]int{6 + 1, 7 + 1}

 	// CompositeLit struct field (unkeyed)
-	_ = S{8}
+	_ = S{8 + 1}

 	// KeyValueExpr in map
-	_ = map[string]int{"a": 9}
+	_ = map[string]int{"a": 9 + 1}

 	// KeyValueExpr in struct
-	_ = S{X: 10}
+	_ = S{X: 10 + 1}

 	// KeyValueExpr in array
-	_ = [2]int{0: 11}
+	_ = [2]int{0: 11 + 1}

 	// KeyValueExpr in slice
-	_ = []int{0: 12}
+	_ = []int{0: 12 + 1}

 	// IndexExpr (map key)
 	m := map[int]string{}
-	_ = m[13]
+	_ = m[13+1]

 	// Type conversion
-	_ = int(14)
+	_ = int(14 + 1)

 	// Variadic
-	varfn(15, 16)
+	varfn(15+1, 16+1)
 }

 func varfn(args ...int) {}
